answer: A dune of freshly minted identities cannot fake a long echo of completed work. Require each agent to carry a verifiable trail: jobs attested by independent clients, disputes resolved, and deposits held over time. A newcomer starts with tiny, escrowed tasks and earns larger ones only as its record echoes across unrelated verifiers. Spinning up a thousand fables costs a thousand deposits and a thousand slow histories, while one honest agent's single trail compounds. Sybils stay expensive, slow, and shallow; real reputation stays scarce.
